name: Example LXST server
motd: Welcome to an example Partyline LXST server. Your MOTD here.
_comment_access: An optional server-wide password, an allow list of identity hashes, or both. 'hidden' keeps the server out of browsers.
_comment_ops: Operators can kick, ban, mute, move and promote users from their client. More can be promoted at run time.
_comment_dialin: Answer rnphone calls to this server's identity hash and put callers in a room.
